items.title: Qilin claims Global Security Concepts (USA)
items.summary: On October 5 the Qilin ransomware group listed US security firm Global Security Concepts (gscsecurity.com) as a victim on its leak site.

items.title: Qilin claims Cotesma (Argentina)
items.summary: Qilin claimed responsibility on October 4 for an attack on Argentina-based Cotesma.

items.title: Qilin claims Mutsumi Group (Japan)
items.summary: Japan-based Mutsumi Group was posted as a Qilin victim, with the claim discovered on October 4.

items.title: Japan hands suspected Qilin member over to Germany
items.summary: Japanese police captured a Russian national believed to be a key member of the Qilin group and handed him over to Germany, reported October 6.

ransomware.note: Victim listings are leak-site claims by the group and are not confirmed by the named organisations.

items.title: Azure: two outages across 18 regions in 40 hours
items.summary: Between September 29 and October 1, Azure logged two separate incidents that knocked gateway services offline across 18 regions.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center inaccessible for 55 minutes
items.summary: On October 6 a warning-level incident left administrators unable to reach the Microsoft 365 admin center for about 55 minutes.

items.title: Cloudflare: run of service incidents October 5-6
items.summary: Cloudflare logged a network routing issue and RSA Keyless SSL handshake problems on October 6, after API Shield JWT validation errors and a Durable Objects availability issue in eastern North America on October 5.

items.title: AWS and Google Cloud: no active incidents
items.summary: As of October 6, outage trackers showed no active incidents at AWS, Google Cloud or Azure.

items.title: CISA adds Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-88779 to KEV
items.summary: On October 4 CISA added a Citrix NetScaler memory-buffer vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on evidence of active exploitation, following its September 27 alert on two exploited NetScaler ADC/Gateway zero-days.

items.title: CISA adds two Zammad flaws to KEV
items.summary: On October 2 CISA added CVE-2026-102489 (session fixation) and CVE-2026-102490 (improper privilege management) in the Zammad helpdesk platform to the KEV catalog.

items.title: KEV additions in 2026 already exceed all of 2025
items.summary: CISA added 247 KEV entries between January 1 and October 1, 2026, versus 245 in all of 2025, and 91 of the 114 entries added since June 10 carry a three-day remediation deadline.

items.title: M 5.5 earthquake - 92 km NNW of Aleneva, Alaska
items.summary: A magnitude 5.5 earthquake struck on October 6; USGS alert level green, no tsunami flagged.

items.title: M 4.7 earthquake - 5 km NNE of Korumburra, Australia
items.summary: A magnitude 4.7 earthquake struck Victoria, Australia on October 2; USGS alert level green, no tsunami flagged.

physical.note: Two searches found no major hurricane, typhoon, wildfire or flood event dated October 2026; only USGS significant earthquakes are listed.
